entities.summary: Brazilian Antarctica is the Antarctic territory south of 60°S, and from 28°W to 53°W, tenuously proposed but unclaimed as a "zone of interest" by geopolitical scholar Therezinha de Castro. While the substance of that designation has never been precisely defined, it does not formally contradict the Argentine and British claims geographically overlapping with that zone.
